notes.title: September Update: New Achievement System!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Achievement System 🔥[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244304/ad98e530671fc8bf1e7ea6552aea0fbec7d804d8.png[/img]
For every map, you can now unlock special achievements by
[list]
[*] Doing Headshots
[*] Keeping your killstreak
[*] Not losing a single life
[/list]
Just for that, we added the "Headshot" mechanism to nearly all of our targets! Let's try-hard guys!

[h1]More Stars to win ⭐[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244304/53ab080f5f96fd9455280be4250e8b4ef4df63db.png[/img]
We added the star-system to the arcade modes. Fight for your 3 Stars on every arcade mode!

[h1]LightWorld complete redesign ✨![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244304/ad4c85ccfe9fb78c32e1a1e16d0bcb0cbfd09814.png[/img]

Go have a loooook and see for yourself!

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards taking ages to load
[*] Invisible actor colliding with bullets in the Lobby
[*] Sound not starting with the app in VR
[*] Menu Actor wasn't visible when using modifiers
[/list]
